verdict.rationale: Glama's docs show the core capability directly: deploying a registry server puts a Gateway in front of it and gives a single hosted endpoint URL with no proxy setup or manual wiring, and every server page provides a pre-filled JSON config to paste into Cursor/Claude/VS Code — matching the story of pointing a client at a remote URL without deploying infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the hosted Gateway endpoint reliably reaches downstream tools in practice (community evidence only discusses quality-score/rebuild issues, not remote connectivity).
